versions.content: AUTOSAR communication shall support an IPDU gateway Type: Valid Description: AUTOSAR communication shall support an IPDU gateway which receives IPDUs and directly sends them out again Rationale: Efficient gatewaying of complete protocol data units from one bus to another Use Case: Gateway between two CAN buses. It could be used in some cases as an efficient alternative for a signal gateway Dependencies: -- Supporting Material: --
